searchText: noticed the `builder_exists` contract still has the `EXCESS_INHIBITOR`, is that intended? we have to make a choice we were able to remove the inhibitor logic for builder_deposits because we added the per-tx fee basically the fee can only rise before the fork if we don't implement per-call fee, then the queue could be spammed with fee 1 before the fork the inhibitor prevents this was there a reason not to add per-x fee for builder exits? I just noticed this while reviewing the EIP imo the per-tx fee makes sense in both contracts, it would also align them more and we can remove anything regarding `EXCESS_INHIBITOR` from the EIP I can make that change! I'll do it in a new PR though For now I want to wrap up the updates for builder_deposits
